disclaimer.short: Research prototype — not a medical device.
disclaimer.long: Ausculta is a research prototype. It does not diagnose illness and does not replace a doctor or health worker.

fictional.title: Sample data
fictional.body: This is made-up information for showing how the app works. It is not a real person and not a real recording.
fictional.shortLabel: Sample data — not a real patient

notConnected.label: Not available yet
notConnected.body: This part of Ausculta is not built yet. Nothing is being measured or calculated here.

confidence.label: How sure the app is
confidence.explanation: This is how sure the app is about its own guess. It is not the chance that you have an illness.

SUGGESTIVE.title: Possible finding
SUGGESTIVE.body: The app heard something in this recording that may need a closer look. This is not a diagnosis. Please show this result to a health worker or a doctor.

NO_ABNORMALITY_DETECTED.title: Nothing unusual detected
NO_ABNORMALITY_DETECTED.body: The app did not hear anything unusual in this recording. This does not rule out illness. If you feel unwell, see a health worker or a doctor even if this result looks fine.

UNCERTAIN.title: Not clear
UNCERTAIN.body: The app could not tell from this recording. This does not mean you are well, and it does not mean you are unwell. Try recording again, or ask a health worker.

INSUFFICIENT_QUALITY.title: Recording was not clear enough
INSUFFICIENT_QUALITY.body: The sound was too noisy or too quiet to check. Nothing has been decided about your health. Please record again somewhere quieter.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.body: There is nothing to show on this screen yet.
